show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Contrarian Quality at GQG Partners – Rajiv Jain (EP.505)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Rajiv Jain is the Chairman and CIO of GQG Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Rajiv Jain is the Chairman and CIO of GQG Partners, a global equity manager he founded in 2016 that has soared to $160 billion in assets. Our conversation covers Rajiv's path from trading in India to his long tenure at Vontobel and founding of GQG. We discuss the periodic crisis lessons that shaped his approach, his definition of quality, team dynamics, and portfolio construction to avoid losses.

key_points.text: Rajiv Jain is the Chairman and CIO of GQG Partners.
We then turn to Rajiv's contrarian views, including current significant positions in energy, utilities, steel, tobacco, and emerging markets, avoidance of hyperscalers and semiconductors.
